subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Visitors enter the train and snake through its corridors and __opulent__ interiors.
solution:
The correct answer is: **economical**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"opulent"** means something that is wealthy, luxurious, or richly decorated. (समृद्ध, विलासितापूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **The opulent mansion was filled with expensive artworks and lavish furnishings.
 
 
 
• **"Economical"** refers to something that is cost-effective, frugal, or not wasteful in terms of resources or money. (मितव्ययी, किफायती)
 
 
• **Example: **Using public transportation is an economical way to travel around the city.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'opulent' **is **'economical'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lavish **(शानदार, भव्य): Sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious.

 
 
• **Example:** The wedding was a lavish affair with a five-course meal and a live orchestra.
 
 
 
• **Scary **(डरावना): Frightening or causing fear.
 
 
• **Example: **The haunted house was filled with scary sounds and eerie lights.
 
 
 
• **Plush** (मुलायम, आरामदायक): Luxuriously soft and comfortable.
 
 
• **Example:** The hotel room had plush furnishings that made it feel very cozy.
